svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Browse the application's news and general information feed daily to keep up with daily inf
ormation. → Avoid missing important information such as major international events and new
job postings.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Search the application for job postings. → Avoid missing important information such as maj
or international events and new job postings.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Receive continuously pushed latest information that matches the taste inferred from the us
er's likes, comments and browsing history. → Browse the application's news and general inf
ormation feed daily to keep up with daily information.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
See how many people are already in a company's hiring process, in order to judge whether t
he company is hiring in large numbers. → Search the application for job postings.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Read feedback from people who recently interviewed at a company, in order to judge how dem
anding its interview process is. → Search the application for job postings.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Filter entertainment content out of the results when the user does not want to see it, so
that useful job and housing content is kept separate. → Search the application for job pos
tings.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Strengthen handling of matrix marketing accounts that post duplicated content and flood th
e feed with irrelevant content. → Browse the application's news and general information fe
ed daily to keep up with daily information.
